structural_frame.description: JSBSim structural frame: x positive aft, y positive right (starboard), z positive up; inches. x origin is near the firewall (Cessna datum style; CG 39 in aft).

offsets.note: Only pitch-deg is set (z-m -0.065 is commented out). No <offsets> on the <model> entry in c172p-main.xml or c172p-set.xml.

origin.value: The FlightGear 3D model origin (after <offsets>) coincides with the JSBSim VRP (34, 0, 35.75 in).
origin.source: FlightGear/JSBSim convention (FDM reports the VRP position to FG); verified numerically, see transform.verification

ac_raw_axes.value: AC3D file raw vertex axes: +x aft, +y up, +z LEFT (port). Right-handed, y-up; can be loaded directly into three.js (which is y-up).
ac_raw_axes.source: Models/c172-common.ac (verified: Spinner x=-2.14 nose, rudder_1 x up to 6.09 tail; wheels at y~-1.3; wing_left/LeftWheel/FuelCapPort at +z)

fg_model_axes.value: FlightGear model/animation XML axes: +x aft, +y right, +z up (meters). Relation: fg = (ac_x, -ac_z, ac_y); ac = (fg_x, fg_z, -fg_y). Animation axes/centers in Models/c172p.xml are in this frame BEFORE the pitch offset is applied (same frame as the AC geometry).
fg_model_axes.source: Models/c172p.xml:5398-5418 (NoseWheel spin center (-1.1149, 0, -1.1889) == NoseWheel AC bbox center (x=-1.1149, y=-1.1889) in Models/c172-common.ac)

transform.description: Structural inches (JSBSim) -> AC3D raw meters (Models/c172-common.ac). Steps: (1) b = 0.0254*(p - VRP) [body m, x aft,y right,z up, origin VRP]; (2) undo the FG pitch offset (-3 deg = model rendered 3 deg nose-down): m_x = b_x*cos3 + b_z*sin3, m_y = b_y, m_z = b_z*cos3 - b_x*sin3; (3) ac = (m_x, m_z, -m_y).

pitch_offset_sign_check.note: RMS of (JSBSim BOGEY contact mapped to AC) minus (AC tyre bottom) over NOSE/LEFT_MAIN/RIGHT_MAIN; -3 deg (as in the XML) gives the best fit.

engine_feed.value: Engine draws only from tank 4 (float chamber, 0.1 lb). Each selected main tank refills tank 4 at a fixed transfer rate whenever tank 4 drops below 0.05 lb.

both_position.value: With BOTH selected, each tank independently supplies 0.1 lb/s while the float chamber needs fuel, so both drain in parallel (~equally).

out_of_fuel_detection.value: outOfFuel = no selected tank with level-gal_us > 0 -> "Out of fuel!" popup

crossfeed.value: Not modelled (no crossfeed/transfer between left and right tanks; only tank->float-chamber transfer).

vent.value: Not modelled in the FDM/systems; the vent exists only as 3D geometry (AC object fuelvent, left wing).

fuel_pump.value: None on the c172p (gravity feed). controls/fuel/fuel-pump only appears in the separate c172sp/FG1000 panel.

primer.value: Manual plunger. Each push/pull cycle increments /controls/engines/engine/primer; start needs 3..6 strokes (<3 "Use the primer!", >6 "Flooded engine!") when oil temp <= 75 degF; primer count resets 5 s after starter release.

location.source: Models/Interior/Panel/c172p-panel/c172p-interior.ac:104581-106800 (object 'PrimerLever', bbox center; instrument panel lower left, converted via frames.transform)

sumps.value: Wing-tank drain sumps are modelled: taking a sample removes 50 ml (0.0132086 gal) and up to 0.2 of the water contamination; returning puts it back. Water contamination >0.2 on a selected tank kills the engine, >0 makes it cough.

master_switch_logic.value: Split master: BAT half (/controls/switches/master-bat) connects battery; ALT half (/controls/switches/master-alt) connects alternator if its voltage exceeds the battery bus voltage; external power (28 V) wins if higher. animations_note: All animation coordinates are given in three frames: fg_model (as written in Models/c172p.xml: x aft, y right, z up, m, pre-offset), ac (raw AC3D file frame: x aft, y up, z left; use this if you load c172-common.ac directly into three.js), struct_in (JSBSim structural inches, after applying the -3 deg pitch offset and VRP origin). Rotation sense follows FG: positive angle is right-handed about the p1->p2 vector (or axis).
